title: tests found implementation bugs
details:
- TC-CAT-1-06: expected 400 with content type application/problem+json and a problem details body with status 400, got 400 with Content-Type 'application/json; charset=utf-8' (body is problem details JSON with status 400) (TypedResults.BadRequest<T> serializes as application/json; the story requires problem details, so the endpoint should return TypedResults.Problem(...) with status 400, which emits application/problem+json and matches the ProducesResponseType annotation) at src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs GetBrandMates (TypedResults.BadRequest<ProblemDetails>), GET /api/catalog/items/{id}/brand-mates?count=0
- TC-CAT-1-07: expected 400 with content type application/problem+json and a problem details body with status 400, got 400 with Content-Type 'application/json; charset=utf-8' (Same cause: BadRequest<ProblemDetails> yields application/json, not application/problem+json) at src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs GetBrandMates, count=13
- TC-CAT-1-15: expected 400 problem+json (count validated before lookup) for unknown id 999999 with count=0, got 400 is returned before the lookup (order is correct) but with Content-Type application/json (Same cause: the validation branch returns BadRequest<ProblemDetails> instead of a Problem result) at src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs GetBrandMates, count validation branch
